title: Fixed VUID-VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo-layout-07988 validation error
implementation_summary: Identified validation error VUID-VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo-layout-07988 during TAA pipeline creation
Root cause was stale compiled shader files in working directory
TAA fragment shader in shaders/ directory was older than build directory version
Synchronized all compiled shaders from build directory to working directory
Fixed shader loading path inconsistency between build system and runtime

key_findings.issue: TAA fragment shader binding 3 validation error
key_findings.root_cause: Old SPIR-V file with binding 3 in shaders/ directory (Sep 13) vs new file in build directory (Sep 15)
key_findings.solution: Copied all compiled shaders from cmake-build-debug-visual-studio/Debug/shaders/ to shaders/

key_findings.issue: Build system vs runtime path mismatch
key_findings.analysis: Build system compiles to build/Debug/shaders/ but runtime loads from shaders/
key_findings.prevention: Need consistent shader deployment or updated loading paths

validation_errors_fixed: Fragment shader binding 3 not declared in pipeline layout
testing_results: TAA pipeline created successfully without validation errors
Debug output confirms RT bindings 3 and 4 added correctly for mesh renderer
debug_output_verified: RT support detection: accelStruct=1 rayQuery=1 rtEnabled=1
Added external TLAS binding 3 for mesh particle renderer
Added shell TLAS binding 4 for mesh particle renderer
TAA pipeline creation now succeeds without validation errors
shader_synchronization: Copied all .spv files from cmake-build-debug-visual-studio/Debug/shaders/ to shaders/
Ensured consistent shader versions between build and runtime
Prevents future validation errors from stale compiled shaders
